title: NouSR enemy profile
description: One kind of enemy: its stats at a fixed level and what it does on its turns. A scenario picks a profile by id and says how many copies are on the field. The layout follows hsr-simulator's enemy files (MIT), with snake_case keys like the scenario format.

id.description: What a scenario's enemies.profile refers to, e.g. "generic-moc".

notes.description: Free text for people, e.g. where the numbers come from. The simulator ignores it.

level.description: Enemy level. Sets the enemy's DEF (200 + 10 x level) and the level term in the damage allies take.

atk.description: ATK at this level, after all of the game's scaling.

spd.description: SPD at this level, after all of the game's scaling.

hp.description: Max HP at this level. Optional. Every enemy copy starts at this and each hit lowers its current HP; in version 1 enemies do not die, so current HP can go below 0 and nothing reacts to it. Without it the simulation still runs, and stops with an error only if a kit asks for an enemy's HP.

toughness.description: Maximum toughness in the game's internal units, the same unit as Fribbels' enemyMaxToughness: the in-game bar value times 3, so a 120 bar is 360 and a 160 bar is 480. (Toughness a hit removes is a different scale: a Basic ATK removes 10 on the bar, 30 in these units.)

res.description: Damage RES to an element the enemy is not weak to, as a fraction. RES to a weakness element is 0.

control_res.description: Control RES as a fraction (the game data's STAT_CTRL resistance). Optional, 0 when left out. Effects whose text says they work only on targets without Control RES (Anaxa's Sublimation) read it; a crowd control roll is not modelled (debuffs always land, decision 4). Floor 12 Memory of Chaos Elites have none; most of its bosses have 0.5 (DESIGN.md, K29).

attacks.description: Everything this enemy can do. Attack ids must be unique.

pattern.description: Attack ids in the order the enemy uses them, one per turn, repeating from the start when it runs out.

target.description: single: one ally, chosen by aggro. blast: one ally chosen by aggro plus the allies next to it. aoe: every ally. bounce: several hits, each on an ally chosen by aggro.

multiplier.description: Damage as a multiple of the enemy's ATK: 2.5 is 250% ATK. For blast this is the main target; for bounce it is each hit.

adjacent_multiplier.description: Blast only, and required for blast: damage to the allies next to the main target.

hits.description: Bounce only, and required for bounce: number of hits.

energy.description: Energy an ally gains each time this attack hits it, before that ally's Energy Regeneration Rate.
